description: Dense dark green turf rim, slightly deeper and richer than open grass, with fine blade tips crowding together, low contrast, no soil showing.
Damp dark packed earth rim, a shade deeper than open dirt, faint crumbled clods gathered close, low contrast, no stones.
Loose wind-piled sand rim, slightly paler and coarser than open sand, faint drift ridging, very low contrast.
Wind-packed snow drift rim, faintly bluer and denser than open snow, soft crusted ripples, very low contrast, no sparkle.
Broken grey scree rim, slightly darker and grittier than open rock, small angular chips crowded together, low contrast.
